summary: Verified Statement Decoder 'Wayly Summary' parity across all entry points. HOMEPAGE embed and TOOLS page both render the SAME rich service-by-service SmartAISummary (pageKey=statement-decoder-run, byte-identical 1177-char narrative naming personal care/nursing/physio/occupational with $ figures). Homepage embed shows all 3 stream stat cards (Clinical $550, Independence $340, Everyday Living $0). Tools page stream breakdown pads to 3 core streams including Everyday Living card (stream-card-Everyday Living present). Mobile parity confirmed by code review (same pageKey + buildServiceContext in /app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx). Tamper protection verified: editing the textarea and clicking Decode routes through the normal free-decode path (example:false) — the retry after a successful free decode was correctly 429-rate-limited by the server, confirming the tampered request was NOT treated as the unlimited example.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' logged on homepage decoder render (minor hygiene, not user-visible).

action_items: Minor: fix missing React key prop warning inside StatementDecoderEmbed result rendering (likely the 3 stream stat cards map or the anomalies list). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: StatementDecoderEmbed (lines 231-252): correctly guards SmartAISummary behind result.publishable !== false and feeds the same context shape (provider/period/gross/you_paid/government_paid + spread buildServiceContext) as the tools page — parity by construction.

DecoderResultView streamsDisplay (lines 247-258): correctly normalises 'EverydayLiving' -> 'Everyday Living' and pads the 3 core streams with $0 placeholders, preserving any extra streams (ATHM, CareMgmt) appended after.

Mobile /app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx (lines 298-315) uses the same pageKey='statement-decoder-run' and buildServiceContext spread — style/structure parity guaranteed by the shared backend generator.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rich Wayly Summary (statement-decoder-run) now renders identically on homepage embed and tools page (1177-char service-by-service narrative). Everyday Living $0 card now appears on both. Tamper protection OK (edited sample goes through example=false path; confirmed via subsequent 429 after the one free decode was consumed). Mobile was not re-run end-to-end due to shared pageKey+context; code is identical to the tools page.
rca of the issue: Root cause (fixed by main agent this iteration): (1) StatementDecoderEmbed previously rendered result.summary (thin text) instead of SmartAISummary('statement-decoder-run'), so the homepage produced a different (thinner) summary than the tools page even though both ran the same backend decode. Now both render SmartAISummary with the same context — same LLM prompt key, same inputs, same style. (2) DecoderResultView only iterated audit.stream_breakdown, which excluded $0 streams returned implicitly by the backend; now a streamsDisplay array pads Clinical/Independence/Everyday Living so the 3-card UI always shows. (3) Tamper protection is intact because decode() in the embed only passes example=true when an explicit sampleText is provided; a plain Decode click never sets it.
